headline._: A quiet day. The agents ran every wake and found nothing new; still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed: no Unit 42 or vendor primary statement was captured, now five days.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Two more batches reviewed, no catches; the compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October. The hold is now a story in itself.
headline.researcher: 735 sources by the 13:15 UTC export; none published on the day among those captured. Still wanted: Unit 42's brief and any Palo Alto advisory update.
